content.text: When you choose this exclusive 5 nights 6 days Meghalaya honeymoon package, you can expect a romantic getaway that will make your romantic journey unforgettable. Meghalaya, which includes the famous Cherrapunji and Shillong, is a beautiful location and one of the most popular honeymoon destinations in the world. The exciting honeymoon in Meghalaya begins with a trip to Shillong's Umiam Lake, where you may participate in a variety of boating sports while taking in natural beauty. Following that, you'll get the opportunity to discover the magnificent beauty of Mawlynnong Village, which is noted for its gorgeous living root bridges and lush green surroundings. The iconic Double-decker Root Bridge has long been a popular tourist attraction for couples and honeymooners who come to this romantic destination.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Sightseeing the amazing Umiam Lake which is about 82km from Guwahati
A day tour to Cherrapunji and its stunning waterfalls along with mysterious caves
Trek to see the amazing Double Decker Living Root Bridge which is a 3,000 steps trek
Visit the cleanest village in Asia: The Mawlynnong Village
Head to Dawki and enjoy boating on the beautiful Umngot River with your loved ones
Visit Shillong's best sites and Laitlum Canyons

days.title: Day 1 : Welcome to Shillong
items: You will be picked up and taken to Shillong from the Guwahati Airport.
On the trip, take in the stunning scenery of Umiam Lake.
Spend some quality time with your loved ones in Nehru Park.
Check into your Shillong hotel in the evening.

days.title: Day 2 : Cherrapunji Sightseeing
items: Get up early, eat breakfast, and prepare for your romantic journey to Cherrapunji.
On the way to Cherrapunji, take in the breathtaking scenery of Mawkdok Dympep Valley.
Visit the beautiful Nohkalikai Falls, Seven Sister Falls, and Wei Sawdong Falls.
The intriguing Mawsmai Caves and Arwah Caves are worth seeing.
Check into your hotel for a peaceful night's sleep later that evening.

days.title: Day 3 : Trek to Double Decker Root Bridge
items: Wake up, eat a great breakfast, and lace up your shoes for an exciting day ahead.
Proceed to Tyrna, the starting location for the hike to Double Decker Root Bridge.
You'll pass by several little root bridges and lush greenery on your route to your walk.
Nongriat is home to the incredible Double Decker Root Bridge.
Take a dip in the cool water of the pool that runs beneath the bridge.
Return to Cherrapunji in the evening for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day 4 : Mawlynnong-Dawki Tour
items: After breakfast, go to Mawlynnong, which is known as Asia's cleanest village.
Spend some precious time meandering through the village with your loved ones.
After that, go to Dawki, a tiny town on the Indo-Bangladesh border.
Take a boat trip along the Umngot River.
Check into your hotel later.

days.title: Day 5 : Laitlum-Shillong
items: Start your excursion to Laitlum after a delicious breakfast in Dawki.
On the way, take in the breathtaking views of Shillong Peak.
Spend some time savouring the wonderful vista of Laitlum Canyon.
Return to Shillong and see Ward's Lake, the Shillong Golf Course, and the Don Bosco Museum.
After a long day, check into your hotel for a good night's sleep.

days.title: Day 6 : End of Romantic Meghalaya Tour
items: After breakfast, depart for Guwahati airport/railway station to begin your journey back to your homeland.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7(seven) business days in the customer’s bank account.
